problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 62 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 48 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 62 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Aster: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Prime: size 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Union: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Inter: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Sect: size 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Caret: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Line: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Grave: size 32 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
